name: Dessourt
overview: Similar to his Desert Treasure I counterpart, he uses a rapid and fairly strong melee attack, as well as a Magic attack that always hits 5s. The most efficient way to kill him is by using melee-resistant armour such as Barrows and attack with Magic; trident of the seas/swamp or Iban blast are effective.
Note: The player cannot use Prayer in this boss fight or any other Recipe for Disaster boss fight.
